canonical_title: Components of a Competency Standard (Unit of Competency)
aliases: Different components of a competency standard
Parts of a unit of competency

one_line_answer.text: A competency standard details skills, knowledge, attitude, performance criteria and evidence to prove competency.

cites.quote: Competency Standard includes details of the skills, knowledge, attitude and the performance criteria to indicate competence and specific evidence required to prove competency.

কোন মানে কাজ করলে competent ধরা হবে
কোন পরিস্থিতি ও শর্তে দক্ষতা প্রযোজ্য

bangla_explanation: Competency standard-এর প্রতিটি unit কয়েকটি নির্দিষ্ট অংশে লেখা থাকে।
Unit code and title নাম দেয়, nominal hours সময় বলে, unit descriptor ছোট summary দেয়।
Elements হলো কাজের মূল activities; performance criteria বলে কোন standard-এ করলে competent ধরা হবে।
Range statement বলে কোন contexts and conditions-এ প্রযোজ্য; evidence guide দেয় assessment-এর guidance।

example.en: A baking unit has the element 'Produce biscuit dough'. Its performance criteria tell the assessor what standard is competent.
example.bn: Element হলো কাজ, performance criteria হলো সেই কাজের মাপকাঠি।

list_answer.title: Components of a competency standard (unit of competency)

items.text: Unit code and title: an area of competence for a particular function.

cites.quote: Unit code and title
The unit title refers to an area of competence required to perform a particular function.

items.text: Nominal hours: suggested hours a novice trainee may take to develop the competency.

cites.quote: Nominal hours
This is a suggested number of hours that a novice trainee may (on average) take to develop the specified competency.

items.text: Unit descriptor: a short summary of the scope and level of performance.

cites.quote: The unit descriptor gives a short summary of the scope and level of performance required.

items.text: Elements of competency: sub components that describe key activities of the work.

cites.quote: Elements of competency or simply elements refer to any of sub component of a unit of competency which describe the key activities or elements of the work covered by the unit.

items.text: Performance criteria: standards of performance needed to be deemed competent.

cites.quote: Performance criteria specify the standards of performance in terms of a set of outcomes which need to be achieved in order to be deemed competent.

items.text: Skills and knowledge requirement: the essential skills and knowledge, and their level, for this unit.

cites.quote: Skills and knowledge requirements refers to the essential skills and knowledge and their level, required for this unit.

items.text: Range statement: the contexts and conditions where the competency is applicable.

cites.quote: The range statement also referred to the range of variables specifies the range of contexts and conditions under which the competency is applicable.

items.text: Evidence guide: guidance to the interpretation and assessment of the unit.

cites.quote: The evidence guide provides guidance to the interpretation and assessment of the unit of competency including

items.text: Accreditation requirements: quality assurance requirements for the training provider.

cites.quote: This provides information for potential training provider and also sets out the quality assurance requirements that have to be met by the training provider

items_bn: Unit code and title — unit-এর পরিচয়; title বলে দেয় কোন particular function করতে কোন area of competence লাগে।
Nominal hours — একজন novice trainee গড়ে কত ঘণ্টায় এই competency অর্জন করতে পারে, তার আনুমানিক হিসাব।
Unit descriptor — পুরো unit-এর ছোট summary; কাজের scope কতটা আর performance কোন level-এর লাগবে তা বলে।
Elements of competency — unit-এর ছোট ছোট অংশ (sub components), যা কাজের মূল activities বর্ণনা করে।
Performance criteria — কোন standard-এ কাজ করলে competent ধরা হবে, সেই মাপকাঠি।
Skills and knowledge requirement — এই unit-এর জন্য কোন skills ও knowledge অপরিহার্য এবং কোন level পর্যন্ত লাগবে, তা বলে।
Range statement — কোন contexts and conditions-এ এই competency প্রযোজ্য, তার সীমা ঠিক করে দেয়।
Evidence guide — unit-টি কীভাবে বুঝতে হবে আর এর assessment কীভাবে হবে, তার guidance দেয়।
Accreditation requirements — training provider-কে কোন quality assurance requirements পূরণ করতে হবে, তা জানায়।

short.prompt: What are the components of a competency standard?
short.modelAnswer:
Each competency standard describes:
1. Unit code and title
2. Nominal hours
3. Unit descriptor
4. Elements of competency
5. Performance criteria
6. Range statement (range of variables)
7. Evidence guide
8. Accreditation requirements

keyPoints.text: Range statements include Occupational Safety and Health legislation, equipment, tools, processes, learner needs, locations.

cites.quote: Legislation such as Occupational Safety and Health
The range of equipment, tools, processes and procedures
Special characteristics and needs of learners group
Particular locations

keyPoints.text: The evidence guide covers underpinning knowledge, assessment emphasis, relationships to other units and required evidence.

cites.quote: the underpinning knowledge, skills and attitude requirements for the unit
the aspects which need to be emphasised in assessment,
relationships to other units, and
the required evidence of competency
